source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), the bearer's unit can regain **destroyed** models:

- up to D3 models
- up to 3 models instead, if you control an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) that unit is in range of

Destroyed **CHARACTER** models in an **Attached unit** can't come back this way. A returned model's **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapons fired before it was destroyed still count as fired.
